VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (order of the planets) Ang 8 planeta ayon sa layo mula sa Araw: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Ang Earth ang pangatlo mula sa Araw.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang planetang Saturn!

Heto ang Saturn! Tanyag ito sa maliliwanag nitong mga singsing na gawa sa di-mabilang na piraso ng yelo at bato na umiikot dito. Ito ang pang-anim na planeta mula sa Araw.

[image: The planet Saturn with its bright rings around it.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (food chain) Ipinapakita ng food chain kung paano dumadaloy ang enerhiya sa pamamagitan ng pagkain. Ang mga halaman ay producers (gumagawa ng sariling pagkain). Ang mga hayop na kumakain ng halaman o ibang hayop ay consumers. Ang mga decomposers (tulad ng fungi at bacteria) ang naglalansag sa patay na bagay pabalik sa lupa.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano po ang hitsura ng ibabaw ng buwan? Gusto ko po makita.

Heto po ang ibabaw ng buwan! Punong-puno ito ng mga malalaking butas na tinatawag na craters, na iniwan ng mga batong mula sa kalawakan na bumagsak doon. Dahil halos walang hangin at ulan sa buwan, hindi nabubura ang mga craters kahit bilyong taon na ang lumipas.

[image: A close view of a large round impact crater on the moon, with smaller craters around it.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why astronauts float in space) Lumulutang ang astronaut dahil sila at ang kanilang spaceship ay parehong patuloy na 'nahuhulog' papunta sa Earth habang umiikot sa paligid nito — kaya wala silang nararamdamang bigat (weightless), hindi dahil walang gravity sa space.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto ko makita ang astronaut na lumulutang sa kalawakan!

Heto ang astronaut! Tandaan mo: may gravity pa rin sa kalawakan. Lumulutang sila dahil sila at ang kanilang spacecraft ay parehong tuloy-tuloy na 'nahuhulog' paikot sa Earth — free fall ang tawag dito — kaya pakiramdam nila ay wala silang bigat.

[image: An astronaut floating weightlessly in space outside the spacecraft.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (action and reaction) Sa bawat tulak ay may katumbas na tulak pabalik (action–reaction). Ang rocket ay tumataas dahil itinutulak nito ang mainit na gas pababa, at bilang ganti, itinutulak ng gas ang rocket pataas.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang rocket habang lumilipad!

Heto ang rocket sa pag-angat nito! Itinutulak nito pababa ang nagliliyab na gas nang napakalakas, at ang katumbas na tulak pabalik ang nagbubuhat dito paitaas — iyan ang action at reaction.

[image: A rocket launching upward with flames and smoke below it.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (how bees make honey) Kinukuha ng bubuyog ang matamis na nectar mula sa mga bulaklak, iniimbak ito, at pinapaypayan gamit ang kanilang pakpak para palaputin tungo sa pulot. Ito ang pagkain ng kolonya sa bahay-pukyutan.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May picture ka ba ng buong solar system?

Meron! Heto ang ating solar system — nasa gitna ang Araw, at umiikot dito ang walong planeta. Ang Earth natin ang pangatlo mula sa Araw.

[image: The solar system showing the sun in the center and the eight planets in order.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (solar system) Ang solar system ay binubuo ng Araw (Sun) at ng walong planeta na umiikot (orbit) dito: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, at Neptune. Ang Araw ay isang bituin (star) na siyang pinagmumulan ng liwanag at init para sa atin.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano ang hitsura ng planetang Mars?

Heto ang Mars! Tinatawag itong 'red planet' dahil mapulang-kayumanggi ang lupa nito — may halong kalawang o rust kasi ito. Ito rin ang planetang pinaka-ineexplore ng mga robot na rover ngayon.

[image: The planet Mars as a round globe with a polar ice cap and dark surface patches.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Philippine volcanoes) Maraming bulkan sa Pilipinas dahil nasa Pacific Ring of Fire ito. Kabilang sa mga sikat: ang Mayon (kilala sa halos perpektong hugis-kono), ang Taal (isa sa pinakamaliit sa mundo), at ang Pinatubo (sumabog nang malakas noong 1991).

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang Bulkang Mayon!

Heto ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay! Sikat ito sa buong mundo dahil sa halos perpekto nitong hugis-kono — bihira ang bulkang ganyan kabilog at kasimetriko ang gilid. Aktibo pa rin itong bulkan hanggang ngayon.

[image: Mayon volcano with its near-perfect cone shape.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (mango has one large seed) Ang bawat mangga ay may isang malaking buto sa gitna na napapaligiran ng matamis na laman. Mula sa isang butong ito maaaring tumubo ang isang bagong puno ng mangga.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May larawan ka ba ng Taal volcano?

Meron! Ang Taal ay isa sa pinakamaliliit na aktibong bulkan sa mundo, pero kakaiba talaga ito: isa itong bulkan na nasa gitna ng lawa. Tingnan mo:

[image: Taal volcano, a small volcano island sitting inside a lake.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why thunder comes after lightning) Sabay nangyayari ang kidlat at kulog, pero nauuna mong makita ang kidlat dahil mas mabilis maglakbay ang liwanag kaysa tunog.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang kidlat!

Heto ang kidlat! Isa itong napakalaking pagputok ng static electricity mula sa mga ulap — mas mainit pa ito sandali kaysa sa ibabaw ng Araw. Kaya nga sinusundan ito ng dagundong ng kulog.

[image: A bright lightning bolt striking down from dark storm clouds.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (the colors of a rainbow) May pitong kulay ang bahaghari: pula, kahel, dilaw, berde, asul, indigo, at lila.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto ko makita ang bahaghari!

Heto ang bahaghari! Nabubuo ito kapag ang liwanag ng araw ay bumaluktot sa loob ng mga patak ng ulan at humiwa-hiwalay sa mga kulay nito. Kaya madalas mo itong makita pagkatapos ng ulan habang may araw.

[image: A rainbow arching over a green field.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why the Philippines has many typhoons) Tumatama sa Pilipinas ang humigit-kumulang 20 bagyo kada taon dahil nasa tabi ito ng mainit na kanlurang Pacific Ocean kung saan madaling bumuo ng bagyo, at ang ihip ng hangin ang nagtutulak ng mga ito papunta sa ating mga isla.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano ang hitsura ng bagyo kapag tiningnan mula sa itaas?

Heto ang bagyo mula sa kalawakan! Mukha itong umiikot na puting spiral ng mga ulap, at sa pinakagitna ay may maliit na butas na tinatawag na mata (eye) — kakatwa, doon mismo kalmado at halos walang hangin.

[image: A typhoon seen from space as a giant spiral of clouds with an eye at the center.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (number of teeth) Ang mga bata ay may 20 na gatas na ngipin (milk teeth); ang matatanda ay may 32 na permanenteng ngipin (kasama ang wisdom teeth).

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo kung paano gumagana ang seesaw.

Heto ang seesaw! Isa itong lever: ang upuan ay isang mahabang bara na umaangat-bumababa sa isang tuntungan sa gitna na tinatawag na fulcrum. Kapag mas mabigat ang isang bata, kailangang umupo siya nang mas malapit sa gitna para magbalanse sila.

[image: Two kids balancing on a seesaw in a playground.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why magnets stick to the fridge) Dumidikit ang magnet sa refrigerator dahil may bakal (iron) sa loob ng pinto nito, at hinihila ng magnet ang bakal.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May picture ka ba ng magnet na may dumidikit na bagay?

Meron! Heto ang magnet na bumubuhat ng pako. Hinihila ng magnet ang mga bagay na may bakal o iron — kaya kapit na kapit ang pako kahit hindi sila magkadikit noong una.

[image: A magnet picking up an iron nail.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (a circuit must be a closed loop) Para dumaloy ang kuryente, kailangan ang isang kompletong saradong daanan na tinatawag na sirkito, mula sa baterya pabalik dito.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman kung ano ang itsura ng simpleng circuit.

Heto ang simpleng circuit! May baterya, mga kawad o wire, at isang bombilya. Kapag sarado at buo ang ikot ng daanan, dadaloy ang kuryente at iilaw ang bombilya — putulin mo ang daanan at mamamatay agad ito.

[image: Building a simple circuit: a battery, two wires, and a small bulb connected so the bulb lights up.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (temperature scales) Sinusukat ang temperatura sa Celsius (°C) o Fahrenheit (°F). Ang tubig ay nagyeyelo sa 0°C = 32°F at kumukulo sa 100°C = 212°F.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano ang hitsura ng pulley? Pakita mo po.

Heto po ang pulley! Isa itong gulong na dinadaanan ng lubid. Kapag hinila mo pababa ang lubid, umaangat ang kabilang dulo — pinapadali nito ang pagbuhat, tulad ng pag-igib ng tubig mula sa balon.

[image: A pulley with a rope raising a bucket of water from a well.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (carabao) Ang kalabaw (carabao) ay isang alagang hayop na tumutulong sa mga magsasaka sa pag-aararo ng bukid, at itinuturing itong pambansang hayop ng Pilipinas.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto ko makita ang kalabaw!

Heto ang kalabaw! Matibay na katulong ito ng mga magsasaka sa pag-aararo ng bukid. Mahilig din itong lumublob sa putik para magpalamig dahil kaunti lang ang pawis nito.

[image: A carabao grazing on grass in a field.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (inertia when a vehicle stops) Kapag biglang huminto ang dyipni, ang mga pasahero ay tila sumusulong pa dahil sa inertia—ang ugali ng katawang gumagalaw na magpatuloy sa paggalaw.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang jeepney.

Heto ang jeepney! Makukulay at puno ng disenyo ang ating pambansang sasakyan. Sa loob nito mo rin mararamdaman ang science — kapag biglang preno, sumusulong pa ang katawan mo dahil sa inertia.

[image: A colorful decorated jeepney.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Banaue rice terraces) Ang Hagdan-hagdang Palayan ng Banaue sa Ifugao ay sinaunang palayan na inukit sa gilid ng mga bundok.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano po ang hitsura ng Banaue Rice Terraces?

Heto po ang Banaue Rice Terraces! Parang malalaking hagdan na inukit ng mga ninuno natin sa gilid ng bundok para mapagtaniman ng palay ang matarik na lupa. Libu-libong taon na ang ilan sa mga ito!

[image: The Banaue rice terraces carved like giant steps into the mountainside.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why we yawn) Humihikab tayo para makahinga nang malalim at makakuha ng maraming hangin, na maaaring tumutulong palamigin ang utak at gisingin tayo. Nakakahawa rin ang hikab — humihikab tayo kapag nakita nating may humikab.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May picture ka ba ng mangga?

Meron! Heto ang mangga — ang pambansang prutas ng Pilipinas. Sa loob ng matamis nitong laman ay may iisang malaking buto, na pwedeng tumubo bilang bagong puno ng mangga.

[image: A mango (mangga) fruit with its golden yellow skin.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (tarsier eyes) Ang tarsier ay may napakalalaking mata na tumutulong dito na makakita sa gabi, at dahil hindi nito magalaw ang mga mata, iniikot nito ang ulo para tumingin sa paligid.
- (Philippine tarsier) Ang tarsier (mawmag) ay isa sa pinakamaliit na primate sa mundo at kasinglaki lamang ng palad ng kamay ng tao.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang tarsier!

Heto ang tarsier o mawmag! Kasinglaki lang ito ng palad mo pero napakalaki ng mga mata nito para makakita sa dilim. Dahil hindi nito magalaw ang mga mata, iniikot na lang nito ang buong ulo para tumingin sa paligid.

[image: A Philippine tarsier with huge round eyes clinging to a branch.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (matter is made of tiny parts) Ang mga bagay ay gawa sa napakaliliit na piraso na minsan ay masyadong maliit para makita ng mata. Ang ibang piraso, gaya ng butil ng asin, ay makikita lang gamit ang magnifying glass.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano ang hitsura ng magnifying glass?

Heto ang magnifying glass! May bilog itong lens na salamin na mas makapal sa gitna at may hawakan. Binabaluktot nito ang liwanag kaya lumalaki ang itsura ng tinitingnan mo — perpekto para sa maliliit na bagay tulad ng langgam.

[image: A magnifying glass with a round lens and a handle.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (pollination) Ang pollination ay kapag ang pollen (alikabok ng bulaklak) ay nalilipat mula sa isang bulaklak patungo sa iba — kadalasan sa tulong ng bubuyog, paruparo, o hangin. Dahil dito, nakakagawa ang halaman ng buto at prutas.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo po kung ano ang itsura ng thermometer.

Heto po ang thermometer! May manipis itong tubo na may likido sa loob. Kapag umiinit, lumalawak ang likido at umaakyat ito sa tubo — kaya ang taas ng likido ang nagsasabi ng temperatura sa iskala.

[image: Reading a liquid thermometer with its scale of numbers.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (magnetism) Ang magnet ay humihila (attract) ng mga bagay na gawa sa bakal o iron. May dalawang dulo ito na tinatawag na poles (north at south). Ang magkaibang poles ay naghihilahan (attract), pero ang magkaparehong poles ay nagtutulakan (repel).

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May larawan ka ba ng compass?

Meron! Heto ang compass. Ang karayom nito ay isang maliit na magnet na malayang umiikot, kaya humahanay ito sa magnetic field ng Earth at laging itinuturo ang hilaga — kaya hindi ka maliligaw.

[image: A compass with its magnetic needle pointing north.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why we see rainbows) Nabubuo ang bahaghari kapag dumaan ang liwanag ng araw sa mga patak ng ulan, na nagbabaluktot at naghahati sa liwanag sa mga kulay nito (refraction).

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May picture ka ba ng paborito kong artista?
Naku, mga larawang pang-agham lang ang dala ko rito! Pero kung gusto mo, maipapakita ko kung paano gumagana ang boses ng isang singer — yung vocal cords na nagvavibrate sa lalamunan. Game ka ba?

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (electricity and circuits) Dumadaloy ang kuryente (electric current) sa isang saradong circuit. Ang conductors (tulad ng metal) ay nagpapadaloy ng kuryente; ang insulators (tulad ng goma at plastik) ay hindi. Kaya ang mga wire ay metal sa loob at goma sa labas para ligtas.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman yung character sa video game na nilalaro ko!

Hindi ko kayang ipakita ang mga video game character — science ang specialty ko! Pero alam mo bang may science din sa paglalaro mo? Maipapakita ko kung paano dumadaloy ang kuryente para gumana ang gadget mo. Gusto mo?
